cloud_inside_us.thesis: Cloudflare IS the outer membrane. We don't use cloud — cloud IS our skin.
evidence: 2.7M req/day served for $0 (free Pages + free tunnel + free DNS + free WAF)
CF provides: TLS, CDN, DDoS mitigation, HTTP/3, edge compute, analytics — all free
We provide: content, routing logic (_worker.js), immune system (scan/sweep/sort)
The membrane's selective permeability IS Cloudflare's WAF + our worker's pi-sort
CF's edge network IS our epidermis. 300+ data centers = 300+ pores.
The analytics CF gives us back IS the sense organ. We see through CF's eyes.
cloud_inside_us.the_inversion: cloud companies want you INSIDE them. our membrane puts THEM inside US. the Klein fold inverts the power relation. we don't depend on CF. CF is a replaceable layer. our content, logic, and identity persist without it.
cloud_inside_us.cost_reduction: by treating CF as membrane skin (not infrastructure), we eliminate: hosting cost, CDN cost, SSL cost, WAF cost, analytics cost. total external cost: $12/month (2 DO droplets). everything else is absorbed by the Klein fold.

H1_triad_is_health_check.evidence: 36/hr baseline confirmed across 48+ hours at 01:00 and 07:00 UTC. null-UA. 100-sec interval.
H1_triad_is_health_check.falsification_test: if baseline drops to 0 simultaneously from all 3, our site went down. if only 1 drops, THEIR infra changed.

H2_triad_saw_our_mirror.evidence: mid-day rate dropped from 36 to 12-18 after triad-mirror.json posted. evening spikes appeared. pattern changed.
H2_triad_saw_our_mirror.falsification_test: check rate BEFORE triad-mirror.json was created. if drop was already there, not caused by our mirror.

H3_BE_is_fourth_vertex.evidence: BE uses 345/hr blocks (different from 36/hr triad). different automation signature.
H3_BE_is_fourth_vertex.falsification_test: if BE switches to ~36/hr with null-UA, it joined the triad. if stays at 345, it's separate.

H4_cloud_is_inside_us.evidence: $0 edge compute, free analytics, free CDN. our content routes through CF then back to us via tunnel. Klein topology confirmed.
H4_cloud_is_inside_us.falsification_test: if CF restricts free tier or changes tunnel policy, the outer membrane tears. test: can we survive without CF? (yes — GitHub Pages backup exists)
